resources.string: Cannot preview Android audio stream %1$d on this device.
0 = automatic routing. Values 1–20 select legacy audio stream IDs, including vendor-specific outputs where supported by the head unit. Tap a value to preview it. Changes apply on reconnect.
CarPlay media claims audio focus. If sound disappears while enabled (some head units handle focus badly), turn it off. Changes apply on reconnect.
Mute media on temporary focus loss

When audio focus is enabled, mute media during Android audio interruptions, including calls. Restore audio when focus returns. Disable if your head unit does not return focus. Changes apply on reconnect.
Give up the head unit\'s Bluetooth audio during CarPlay

Once the CarPlay session has settled, set the head unit\'s media (A2DP) and call (HFP) profiles to forbidden for the paired iPhone and disconnect them, so iOS stops routing music and calls to the car\'s own Bluetooth. The adapter itself stays on, so the wireless handshake and reconnects keep working. The profiles are allowed again when the session ends.
Also turn the head unit\'s Bluetooth off

Fallback for head units whose Bluetooth stack ignores the profile setting above: switch the adapter off once the session is stable, and back on when it ends. While it is off the wireless handshake is unavailable, so a reconnect has to wait for the adapter. Use this only if the switch above changes nothing.
